abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, so the counters were never placed. 'Enters the arena with N counters' happens ONCE, when it enters -- an ON_ENTER_PLAY trigger, not a continuous static, which would have kept adding counters had it run at all.

_comment: The counter effect named a target and the compiler read none of it, so the counter went on the source card. 'an ally you control' is a type filter over the arena. The PUT_COUNTER half targets self ('enters the arena with a +1{p} counter') and was already correct.
